purpose: Register a four-arm, validation-only screen for whether signed train-only ACF relation learning should supervise the default encoder representation or a window-level summary of the final normalized MambaACF forecast.
research_question: Under an otherwise identical static raw-prior MambaACF AutoCon contract, does routing the global signed relation objective through the final normalized forecast's window-level cross-channel summary improve validation behavior beyond the default encoder-projection route?
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory H96 screen on ETTh1 and traffic with three paired seeds per arm. It is a routing-mechanism test only; it cannot establish a general Mamba, ACF, AutoCon, accuracy, efficiency, or publication claim.
claim_boundary: The forecast view changes only the training-time relation representation. The current global loss averages its [B,H,C] relation view over H, so it supervises a window-level cross-channel forecast summary rather than stepwise forecast dynamics. It reuses the final normalized prediction and adds no prediction-only parameter, structural MAC, or activation cost, but can add training-time loss/backward cost, especially on traffic. It requires at least two channels. Do not call it an end-to-end speed improvement.

required_before_launch: human review of the four-arm routing and difference-in-differences design
verify the current source snapshot, environment record, and both dataset SHA256 fingerprints
run current-source CUDA shape/backward and device-resident resource smokes for encoder and forecast relation views
measure prediction-only and training-step cost separately; the lambda-zero arms still compute the relation path and are not an auxiliary-path throughput control
freeze this JSON, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root
select or stop an arm using validation metrics only

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, relation representation, lambda arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh exploratory output root. Retain the immutable runner source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan hash, config hashes, manifest, train-only ACF prior, validation trajectory, loss diagnostics, checkpoint, and phase validation. Do not copy historical metrics or checkpoints into this matrix.

phases.name: encoder_relation_null_h96
phases.purpose: Null control for the historical encoder-projection relation route; the relation objective is evaluated for identical telemetry but its coefficient is exactly zero.

phases.name: encoder_relation_h96
phases.purpose: Historical encoder-projection relation route with the registered nonzero signed ACF auxiliary coefficient.

phases.name: forecast_relation_null_h96
phases.purpose: Null control for the direct normalized-forecast relation route; it retains the same route and telemetry while setting the relation coefficient to zero.

phases.name: forecast_relation_h96
phases.purpose: Treatment arm: use the final normalized [B,H,C] forecast as the global signed ACF relation representation. The global loss averages forecast steps, while its gradient reaches forecasting branches directly.

relation_representation_contract.primary_estimand: (forecast_relation_h96 minus forecast_relation_null_h96) minus (encoder_relation_h96 minus encoder_relation_null_h96), paired by dataset, horizon, and seed.
relation_representation_contract.interpretation: The two zero-lambda controls retain their own representation route and calculate the relation objective for telemetry, but its gradient coefficient is zero. They prevent a routing-specific training path, tensor-shape, or random-number effect from being misread as a nonzero relation-loss benefit; they are not a disabled-auxiliary throughput control.

comparison_contract.relation_telemetry_boundary: A finite relation loss is not enough. Report candidate count, contrastive-active anchor fraction, degenerate-positive fraction, and sign accuracy for every arm; absent denominator support invalidates a representation-learning interpretation.
comparison_contract.resource_boundary: Prediction-only parameters and structural MACs are expected to match because the forecast view only aliases an already computed normalized prediction. Measure prediction-only latency separately from a full forward/loss/backward training step because [B,H,C] can be much larger than [B,L,D] on high-dimensional data. Lambda-zero arms still calculate the relation path, so they cannot estimate the cost of disabling it.
comparison_contract.promotion_rule: Promote no arm directly. A favorable, complete 24-job screen only motivates a separately human-reviewed frozen replication with more datasets, horizons, seeds, strong baselines, and a one-time held-out test protocol.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validation and dry-run expansion are the only permitted actions for this draft.
Invalidate the routing readout if any coordinate is missing or duplicated, a source/sidecar/config hash differs within a paired coordinate, or relation diagnostics are absent/non-finite.
Do not infer a routing benefit from forecast-active versus encoder-active alone; report the two within-view lambda contrasts and their paired difference-in-differences.
Do not use test metrics, historical artifacts, or a prediction-only latency row to choose the route, lambda, horizon, or make an end-to-end speed claim.

If the direct route fails to improve its own zero-lambda control or costs materially more per training step without a validation benefit, stop this branch rather than folding it into a larger architecture.
